title: cheilanthes glauca
intro: Cheilanthes glauca, commonly known as the Blue Rasp fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its various health benefits, including the ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Cheilanthes glauca include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and anti-hemorrhagic properties, making it a valuable treatment for wounds, burns, and other skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
